title: Complete cleanup run
statement: Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer and let $w$ and $s$ be Boolean words. There is a time $t\le 2|s|+|w|+5$ at which the cleanup machine, started in its scan configuration at count $0$, is in state $(4,\mathrm{false})$, with input head at position $1$, all work heads at position $0$, the word obtained by appending one $1$ to $s$ if $|s|\le |w|$ and otherwise leaving $s$ unchanged on the first work tape, all other work tapes blank, and empty output.
replaced:
For any input $w$ and candidate $s$, there is a time
$t \le 2\abs{s} + \abs{w} + 5$ after which the cleanup machine, started at
the beginning of its scan phase, reaches the canonical anchored
configuration, in its return state, whose stored words carry one
split-search step applied to $s$; every transition on the way is silent.
